title: Siege of Santiago
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Santiago", at revision 1370745046, opens: "The siege of Santiago, also known as the siege of Santiago de Cuba, was the last major operation of the Spanish–American War on the island of Cuba." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7510374, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1898 siege during the Spanish-American War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
